correctness.rationale: Each adjacent column square forces the occupied deletion columns to cover the cyclic column graph. Given a cover, contracting surviving rungs gives exactly the column cycle with double-deleted vertices removed and with edges at opposite-rail singleton pairs removed. No parallel edges are created even for n=3, and contraction preserves components and cycle rank. When there are only singleton deletions, the complement is a forest exactly when there is at least one cut, and then the cut count equals the component count. An odd minimum cover has one adjacent occupied pair, and its r complementary independent vertices have cyclic gaps of one unselected vertex each with one extra unselected vertex. This gives 2r+1 covers; the one cut imposes one independent rail constraint, so (2r+1)2^r trees. In even order, budget r forces alternating single deletions and no cut; at budget r+1 either one double in an alternating cover gives a path, or the singleton cover has two adjacent occupied pairs. The cyclic positive-gap count for its r-1 complementary independent vertices is (2r/(r-1))*binom(r,r-2)=r^2, including r=2. The two prescribed cut bits give independent constraints since the induced graph on the occupied columns is a forest, even if the pairs share a column. Each fixed bit pattern admits 2^(r-1) assignments; the patterns with one and two cuts occur twice and once, respectively. Adding the 2r*2^(r-1) one-double choices gives all three stated counts and attained induced-tree order.
residual_risks: The recorded finite n=3..12 enumeration is corroborative only; it was not freshly replayed. Counts are labeled, not orbit counts.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification of extremizers in a basic cubic family, not just a minimum-size or small-instance computation. The reduction to a column cycle explains the obstructions, distinguishes connected and disconnected extremizers, and parametrizes all optimal subsets. This is useful structural mathematical content independent of the originality failure; the component formulas alone are not an additional contribution beyond the matched structural theorem.
residual_risks: No extra value claimed from recomputing the already implied component split, and no generalization to larger cylindrical widths is established.
